The '''''Whisper''''' was a [[3-Z light freighter]] that was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] team the [[Gray Griffins]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the Gray Griffins were assigned to perform some exploration work on the behalf of the [[Radell Mining Corporation]], the Griffins flew the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] to the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] and they discovered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alluuvia]]. However, the ''Whisper'' was captured by [[The Scourge]], a local [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group, and the Griffins were imprisoned. The pirates then sold the freighter to the [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Slythor]], who stored the vessel in [[Realspace/Legends|space]], near to the planet [[Korad]].

A team of Rebel Alliance agents were sent to recover the co-ordinates of Alluuvia from the ''Whisper''{{'s}} [[Computer/Legends|computer]] and the agents negotiated with Slythor for access to the freighter. A pair of Slythor's [[Asteroid hopper|Verpine hoppers]] escorted the agents to the ''Whisper''{{'s}} location and the Rebels entered the vessel. However, during its time near Korad, the ''Whisper'' had became infested with [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]] and [[space mite]]s, and the creatures attacked the agents. The Rebels defeated the creatures, then obtained the co-ordinates and departed Korad.
